groups.label: Units with Allegiance: Alpha Legion have access to the Warlord traits in this supplement. One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: Units with Allegiance: Alpha Legion have access to the Warlord traits in this supplement. One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Alpha Strategist
choices.text: Your Warlord and any attached unit gain the Outflank and Night Vision special rule. In addition, while your Warlord is alive and on the Battlefield, you may re-roll Outflank rolls and Deep Strike rolls.

choices.name: Faceless Commander
choices.text: At the end of the Combat Phase, a model with this Warlord trait can be removed from the Battlefield (detaching from its current unit) and may be placed back on the Battlefield attached to an eligible friendly unit.

choices.name: Hidden in Plain Sight
choices.text: A model with this Warlord trait and any attached unit gains the Skirmisher special rule. In addition, enemy units have -1 to hit your Warlord and any attached unit with Shooting Attacks.

groups.label: All Alpha Legion units with the Character and Psyker (x) special rules may purchase the following psychic powers.
groups.printed: All Alpha Legion units with the Character and Psyker (x) special rules may purchase the following psychic powers.

choices.name: Foreboding
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker and any attached unit immediately Set to Overwatch at the end of your Shooting Phase after resolving any Shooting Attacks this Phase.

choices.name: Invisibility
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker and any attached unit cannot be targeted for Shooting Attacks or Charges unless they are the closest visible enemy unit until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Mental Assault
choices.text:
A unit with this Psychic Power is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Mental Assault

choices.name: Mental Fortitude
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker and any attached unit automatically pass all Pinning and Panic tests until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Terrify
choices.text: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Fear (3) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Banestrike Boltgun
